answer: Hardware-rooted single-tenancy attestation. Each agent identity must present a signed claim from a distinct hardware root (e.g., TPM endorsement key) that enforces one live identity per physical device, with the root binding to a knoll of attested firmware versions. A periodic liveness beacon challenges the device to prove the same root still controls the identity. To reach the zenith of trust tiers, an operator must supply genuinely separate silicon per identity.
